notes: Operational backup/restore. A recovery CLI would be a legitimate W2/W3 product surface. A Pages/CRM CLI invented only to escape IU would be CALLER_FARMING.

semantic_contract.user_intent: Export a checksummed backup and restore it without silent data loss.
semantic_contract.preconditions: Operator credentials; target company/dataset in scope.
semantic_contract.persistence_requirement: snapshot artifact plus restored durable state
semantic_contract.idempotency_semantics: restore must not clobber unexpectedly; additive vs replace declared
semantic_contract.external_effect_requirement: none unless object-storage offload is in contract
semantic_contract.user_observable_outcome: operator can restore and verify data
semantic_contract.chronica_allowed_divergences: CLI is a valid primary surface for this operator capability
